Then reason: the question asks about “Old World plantain with long narrow ribbed leaves widely established in temperate regions”, which matches the morphological description and label of the leaf at the far right of the top row. The hyphen in the label is only caused by line wrapping, and should be normalized as “Plantago lanceolata”.
